selection: Targeted, non-systematic review of eight model families and relevant conditional generation/evaluation antecedents; not exhaustive priority research.
source_policy: Only author manuscripts, official proceedings/publisher records and author research pages substantiate claims. No secondary summaries are relied on.
read_scope_policy: Current-session web verification plus explicitly identified selected readings from existing, preserved primary-source logs. No record asserts a complete-paper/proof replication.
first_paper_policy: Seminal/key references are not asserted to be the absolute earliest occurrence of every underlying idea.

records.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
records.read_scope: Metadata; selected PDF §§2.1–2.4, ELBO Eqs1–7 and minibatch Algorithm1.
records.supports: Reparameterized variational training with an amortized approximate posterior.
records.claim_limits: A likelihood lower bound is not exact marginal likelihood or a perceptual-quality guarantee.
records.metadata_note: Year denotes first preprint, not a claim of earliest latent-variable modeling; commonly cited as ICLR2014.

records.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 27
records.read_scope: Publisher metadata; PDF §3 Eq1 and adjacent training description.
records.supports: A generator learns through a discriminator's adversarial training signal.
records.claim_limits: The ideal unrestricted equilibrium does not establish finite-network or Adam convergence.

records.title: The Neural Autoregressive Distribution Estimator
records.read_scope: Official bibliography; PDF §§3–4, chain factorization and normalized conditional construction.
records.supports: Tractable autoregressive density estimation and ancestral generation.
records.claim_limits: Representative early neural estimator; probability chain factorization predates NADE.

records.title: Density estimation using Real NVP
records.read_scope: Metadata; selected PDF §§3.1–3.2, change-of-variables and coupling-layer definitions.
records.supports: Bijective coupling transformations permit tractable density evaluation and inverse sampling.
records.claim_limits: Exact model density is distinct from exact recovery of the data distribution.
records.metadata_note: A seminal tractable flow architecture, not the origin of the change-of-variables formula or all normalizing flows.

records.title: Deep Unsupervised Learning using Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics
records.read_scope: Official metadata and abstract; forward-corruption/learned-reversal description.
records.supports: Early deep diffusion modeling through a forward process and learned reverse transitions.
records.claim_limits: Historical mechanism citation; no full proof or experimental audit in this review.

records.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33
records.read_scope: Metadata; selected PDF §§2–3.2, epsilon parameterization, Algorithms1–2 and Eq12.
records.supports: Gaussian diffusion can be trained using a noise-prediction objective and sampled by learned reverse steps.
records.claim_limits: The simplified training loss reweights the variational objective; finite sampling remains approximate.

records.title: Generative Modeling by Estimating Gradients of the Data Distribution
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32
records.read_scope: Metadata; selected PDF §§2.1–2.2 and noise-conditional-score introduction.
records.supports: Noise-conditioned denoising scores support annealed Langevin generation.
records.claim_limits: Smoothed-density scores and finite Langevin updates are not exact original-density samples.

records.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
records.read_scope: Metadata; author HTML §§3.1–3.3, Eq6 reverse SDE and §4.3 Eq13 probability-flow ODE.
records.supports: A continuous-time score framework connects diffusion, reverse SDEs and deterministic probability flow.
records.claim_limits: Equal exact marginals require the stated exact-score/regularity setting; practical solvers introduce error.

records.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
records.read_scope: Metadata; HTML §§3–4.1, Eqs5–15 and statements of Theorems1–3; proofs not audited.
records.supports: Conditional vector-field regression supplies gradients for a marginal transport path.
records.claim_limits: Simulation-free training does not mean simulation-free sampling or automatic maximum-likelihood optimization.

records.title: Consistency Models
records.read_scope: Official bibliography; selected PDF §§2–3: PF trajectory, self-consistency, boundary and sampling; training overview.
records.supports: Trajectory-consistent mappings permit one-step and multistep generation, with distillation or standalone training.
records.claim_limits: One evaluation by design does not establish universal superiority, exact density or zero training cost.

records.title: cGANs with Projection Discriminator
records.read_scope: Primary metadata and abstract; conditional projection and cBN role.
records.supports: Inner-product projection is an established way to incorporate labels into a GAN discriminator.
records.claim_limits: The present small residual network is an adaptation, not a reproduced official benchmark.

records.title: Generative Moment Matching Networks
records.read_scope: Official metadata/abstract; MMD objective and feedforward generative mechanism overview.
records.supports: MMD supplies a differentiable generative training criterion without the original GAN minimax game.
records.claim_limits: Identifiability depends on the kernel and distribution class; finite fitted moments alone are insufficient.

records.title: Improved Techniques for Training GANs
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 29
records.read_scope: Metadata; selected PDF §3.1 feature matching and adjacent nonconvergence discussion.
records.supports: Generator matching of intermediate discriminator statistics is an established GAN training idea.
records.claim_limits: Its heuristic training motivation is not a general convergence or minority-coverage theorem.

records.title: Conditional Generative Moment-Matching Networks
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 29
records.read_scope: Publisher metadata; primary PDF title page; prior selected §§2.3–3.1 read log retained in v2.
records.supports: Conditional-kernel moment matching predates the present four-group feature-contrast design.
records.claim_limits: A single signed contrast does not inherit full conditional-embedding identifiability.
records.metadata_note: Author order follows the primary PDF. Publisher HTML displays Ren, Zhu, Li, Luo; discrepancy explicitly retained.

records.title: McGan: Mean and Covariance Feature Matching GAN
records.read_scope: Official metadata/abstract; prior selected PDF §§2–3.1 and §4.1 opening.
records.supports: Finite-feature mean and covariance IPMs are established adversarial discrepancies.
records.claim_limits: Matching finitely many feature statistics need not identify every image distribution.

records.title: Fisher GAN
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30
records.read_scope: Current primary metadata/abstract; prior selected PDF §§2.1–2.2 through Eq5.
records.supports: A second-moment-constrained critic leads to normalized feature-mean matching.
records.claim_limits: Second-moment normalization is not the proposed cluster-target uncertainty estimate.

records.title: Learning Implicit Generative Models by Matching Perceptual Features
records.read_scope: Primary PDF §§2.1–2.2, Eqs1–4; selected §3 identifiability assumptions.
records.supports: GFMN precomputes real feature targets and uses moving-discrepancy linear surrogates.
records.claim_limits: Especially close precedent; no first fixed-teacher or first lagged-witness claim is justified.

records.title: Amortized Moment Matching for Visual Generation
records.read_scope: Primary metadata; HTML §3 statements and §§4.1–4.2 Eqs9–21; not proofs or experimental validation.
records.supports: AMFD learns conditional moments; Eq16 uses a detached mean-discrepancy linear generator objective.
records.claim_limits: Preprint method antecedent, not proof of our novelty, performance, cluster validity or full-distribution identification.

records.title: Fair Generative Modeling via Weak Supervision
records.read_scope: Current official metadata/abstract; prior selected PDF §§2–3, Eqs3–5 and Algorithm1.
records.supports: An unlabeled reference set supports density-ratio correction toward a specified reference distribution.
records.claim_limits: Requires appropriate reference/support and estimated ratios; not an unconditional fairness guarantee.

records.title: Inclusive GAN: Improving Data and Minority Coverage in Generative Models
records.read_scope: Current metadata/abstract; prior author HTML §§3.3–3.4,4.1,4.5 and SupplementA.
records.supports: Combines adversarial learning with reconstructive generation, including minority-focused coverage.
records.claim_limits: Coverage objective and original compute differ from this small four-bin GAN study.

records.title: NoisyTwins: Class-Consistent and Diverse Image Generation through StyleGANs
records.read_scope: Current metadata/abstract; prior HTML §§3.2,4.1–4.2, embedding-noise and twins objectives.
records.supports: Long-tail StyleGAN training can address class-latent collapse through embedding augmentation and decorrelation.
records.claim_limits: Its architecture and datasets differ; no imported gains or budget-matched comparison.

records.title: Improving GANs for Long-Tailed Data through Group Spectral Regularization
records.read_scope: Current primary metadata/abstract; historical author-code provenance in v1 source ledger.
records.supports: gSR regularizes conditioning matrices to address observed tail-class spectral growth and collapse.
records.claim_limits: No guarantee for every long-tail distribution; not a completed comparator in the final B/C cohort.

records.title: Compositional Visual Generation with Composable Diffusion Models
records.read_scope: Metadata; author HTML §§3.2–4.2 through conjunction factorization; not complete experimental audit.
records.supports: Energy/score composition offers inference-time conjunction and negation of learned concepts.
records.claim_limits: Correct composition needs modeling assumptions; rare-seen bins do not demonstrate zero-shot composition.

records.title: Demystifying MMD GANs
records.read_scope: Metadata; author HTML abstract, §2.1 and §4 KID definition; no complete proof audit.
records.supports: KID is an MMD-based fixed-feature evaluation statistic with an IID U-statistic estimator.
records.claim_limits: IID unbiasedness does not transfer automatically to clustered heldout images or model selection.

records.title: On Aliased Resizing and Surprising Subtleties in GAN Evaluation
records.read_scope: Primary metadata/abstract and selected PDF introduction; CVF HTML returned403.
records.supports: Resizing, antialiasing and compression can materially change feature-based GAN scores.
records.claim_limits: A standardized preprocessing path improves comparability but does not certify semantics or fairness.

records.title: Reliable Fidelity and Diversity Metrics for Generative Models
records.read_scope: Official metadata; PDF §2.2 Eqs1–3 and §3.2 Eqs4–5.
records.supports: Feature-neighborhood precision, recall, density and coverage diagnose distinct sample properties.
records.claim_limits: Feature choice, sample size and neighborhood settings matter; density can exceed one.

records.title: Deep Learning Face Attributes in the Wild
records.read_scope: Primary arXiv metadata/abstract; CVF HTML403; author project metadata in historical ledger.
records.supports: Dataset and attribute-prediction provenance for CelebA.
records.claim_limits: Annotation names are dataset labels; neither demographic ground truth nor a license expansion.

records.title: Do We Train on Test Data? Purging CIFAR of Near-Duplicates
records.read_scope: Primary metadata/abstract and journal-reference field.
records.supports: CIFAR duplicate contamination demonstrates why split membership alone can misrepresent generalization.
records.claim_limits: CIFAR evidence does not establish any CelebA duplicate count; those are separate project measurements.

records.title: Distributionally Robust Language Modeling
records.read_scope: Current official metadata; prior selected PDF §§4.2–5.1, Eqs8–11 and EMA/floor allocation.
records.supports: Historical group-loss allocation and moving estimates precede critic-gap weighting.
records.claim_limits: Language-model topic robustness does not establish GAN convergence or critic-gap robustness.

records.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
records.read_scope: Current primary metadata/abstract and HTML method headings; prior selected §§3.1–3.3 Eqs1–3.
records.supports: Perceptual compression moves denoising into latent space; cross-attention handles general conditions.
records.claim_limits: Compression/autoencoder training has costs and losses; not an executed baseline here.

records.title: Conditional Generative Adversarial Nets
records.read_scope: Primary abstract and bibliographic metadata
records.supports: Conditions are supplied to both generator and discriminator.

records.title: Spectral Normalization for Generative Adversarial Networks
records.read_scope: Primary abstract and bibliographic metadata
records.supports: Discriminator weight normalization is proposed for GAN stabilization.

records.title: A Kernel Two-Sample Test
records.read_scope: Primary publisher metadata and selected PDF sections 1 and 2 on characteristic RKHS mean embeddings and MMD
records.supports: MMD compares distributions through RKHS mean embeddings.

records.title: MADE: Masked Autoencoder for Distribution Estimation
records.read_scope: Primary publisher metadata and model abstract; masking idea independently checked against code dependency structure.
records.supports: Degree masks restrict each conditional output to preceding inputs in a fixed ordering.
records.claim_limits: The new local Gaussian masked MLP is a pedagogical adaptation, not a faithful binary-NADE implementation or an official MADE reproduction.
